notes.title: Cards We're Dealt Directors Cut Update
notes.content:
Cards We're Dealt 1.0.4.8 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/4b6f77b12f5a7ad9870065e3ad4d08b2846f4643.gif"]


Directors Cut Part IV is here! This concludes all remaining changes I wanted to make to the game for the time being! The game will launch everywhere next month.


 Changes:

Cards We're Dealt Prologue now available for free on Xbox as a demo 

Added parking garage floor in "Escape"

Added new animation for players tripping

Fix game settings and stats not resetting when restarting from lobby menu

Minor bug fixes


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/e22295a5d67d9b27430472cf6bfdc0eb28efd04d.gif"]


Hope you all appreciated the journey as much as me.
Next time you hear from me the game will be out on Playstation. 
Back to work on Tiny Planet... 
Love you. Appreciate everyone's patience. 

Thanks for playing, 

Cole

notes.title: 3 New Cards! - Cards We're Dealt 1.0.3.0
notes.content:
Cards We're Dealt 1.0.3.0 🃏 

I'm back and so is Cards We're Dealt! I've got a new update here today adding 3 new cards as well as providing multiple bug fixes. I've got more plans in store soon but let me know what you wanna see next!
Thanks for all the support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/188b8672cc266340f310b5acc8311e3bd84e65c6.gif

Changelog:

 Added NEW CARD - GOLDEN TICKET
 Added NEW CARD - KEY COMPASS
 Added NEW CARD - SHUFFLE
 Fix desync during level generation in online
 Fix various falling under the map glitches
 Fix occasional multiple pause menus spawning
 Denote passive or active cards on each card in inventory
 Fixed “T-rex arms” Perma card enemies couldn't touch players at all
 Fixed in multiplayer, if two controller players we're both trying to throw away cards, if they click "A" it also makes the other click "A" and vise versa
 Fixed perma cards sometimes appearing twice in hand (was just a visual bug)
 On level 3, only reveal the elevator hallway after both keycard and the terminal is linked and can be down in either order now
 Minor bug fixes for online
 Performance improvements
 Made some achievement values easier to achieve


Love you. 
Thanks for playing,

 Cole

notes.title: Cards We're Dealt - Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Cards We're Dealt now has a Demo!

Wander haunted halls as an office temp and collect magical cards with supernatural abilities to fight demons and save the office from being dragged to hell in this horror, deckbuilding, roguelike game

Experience a little bit of what is in store for you when it launches later this year! To see what's in store for you, also check out this new trailer!

[previewyoutube=XdUWq1gQCmM;full][/previewyoutube]

Can you collect all the cards in the devils deck? Check out the demo now and let me know what you think and if you can escape.

notes.title: Beta Testing Sign Up Now Available!
notes.content:
Attention Interns 🃏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/4c2fb988f245b3001603e668a684271e9daa65b2.gif

You may now sign up to be part of the upcoming Card's We're Dealt early access group
This group will have early access to the upcoming Demo to provide feedback and improve the experience before it launches.
By applying you also are eligible for full game early access testing in a couple months.

If you are interested in uncovering what evils lurk below and provide feedback to polish the experience,
please visit the form below to declare your interest

https://forms.gle/PLF6ArD7MxKrqioF7

If you are eligible and selected you will be notified within the next few weeks.

Do note, in order to participate in the early access you must be a member of our discord in order to communicate

You can join the official discord here:
https://discord.gg/mXMgGSc
